svg.title: Complementary research with an expanded circular curation–expression mechanism
svg.desc: Fusion of framework_proagent_en_v2 and the white-background orbit design. Empirical analysis occupies approximately 35 percent and simulation 65 percent of the main research area. The main loop connects visibility configuration, selective expression and content recirculation; current contact independently updates history for later R. Authors retain fixed types. Curves and icon counts are schematic. Memorial bouquet and candle indicate context only. No individual platform quantities or proportions are displayed.
